lxc_38a5b2a4fdea0bf0.text: Iron Man is Marvel Comics hero Tony Stark, a genius inventor who fights in a powered armor suit he builds himself.

lxc_0e0bc7f288598ce3.text: Iron Man is a superhero from Marvel Comics.

lxc_a75d05027d4c5ed8.text: Under the metal, he is a normal man.

lxc_bcd948a02b167477.text: His name is Tony Stark, and his full name is Anthony Edward Stark.

lxc_a645baefa529837f.text: Tony is very rich, and he is also a genius.

lxc_b48c74b93317b9cf.text: He is an inventor and an engineer.

lxc_1caf8cc1ba39874d.text: That means he designs machines and builds them with his own hands.

lxc_22706be44a7899c8.text: He does not come from space.

lxc_cb5560debe72ff63.text: His power is his powered armor suit.

lxc_521d4790330ba33e.text: This suit is a strong metal body that he wears.

lxc_87de92c0a815f946.text: It lets him fly, and it protects him.

lxc_b3c0977442023d58.text: In the comics, the armor is red and gold.

lxc_1dd67bcda505bed4.text: So when we talk about Iron Man, we really talk about two things at the same time: the smart man inside, and the suit he made.

lxc_a2f89e740d427517.text: Iron Man was made by a small team at Marvel Comics.

lxc_75ea5e4344f17675.text: Stan Lee was the editor, and he had the first idea for the character.

lxc_5de71db6d728a21a.text: Larry Lieber wrote the words of the first story.

lxc_5140f9bdca1f2b23.text: Don Heck drew the story and designed how Tony Stark looked.

lxc_b5564dec94e94267.text: Jack Kirby designed the cover and the first armor.

lxc_0227e99ef78262bb.text: So four people worked together, and each one added one piece.

lxc_3e8489464bbbfc50.text: Iron Man first appeared in a comic book called Tales of Suspense.

lxc_1b74bdddc2769ed7.text: This was a Marvel series with many short stories in one book.

lxc_4f761caeda3b54ea.text: Iron Man was in issue number 39.

lxc_cd61d58028dab6d2.text: After that, Iron Man returned in more Tales of Suspense stories and later series.

lxc_b23f4f3df09caf15.text: Now let us look at the story itself.

lxc_0539b394d3bd0f77.text: A good way to follow it is this: problem, invention, result.

lxc_f648effadce9a8e5.text: Tony Stark is a rich weapon maker.

lxc_8f26a6c8cdd404d8.text: He goes to a war zone, and he is hurt and taken captive.

lxc_4e2ec85f21812941.text: He is a prisoner, and he is badly injured.

lxc_81b079b9837ad496.text: Tony is still an engineer, even in a prison.

lxc_efdcd9e57f682e44.text: He works in secret with the parts around him.

lxc_2fe08707252e0cb7.text: He builds a heavy metal suit to keep his body alive and to fight his way out.

lxc_023b41d54d717b4b.text: He escapes in the armor, and he goes home a changed man.

lxc_89b9f4e85b16a704.text: This is why armor and technology are the heart of the character.

lxc_26806939277b5fd7.text: Tony does not find his power.

lxc_a77afb82e34697c4.text: He builds it, step by step, with his mind.

lxc_96c7ebfdec7440c6.text: Many years later, the story moved to the cinema.

lxc_7d648c737a090c94.text: The film Iron Man came out in the United States on May 2, 2008.

lxc_635173bf945b75c7.text: played Tony Stark and Iron Man.

lxc_8249e2dc610b8f94.text: The film was made by Marvel Studios, and it was their first film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, or MCU.

lxc_cfd0db09ac4fb47e.text: The film follows the same problem, invention, result idea from the comics.

lxc_24747ccf35060cc5.text: Tony is captured, he builds a suit, and he becomes a hero.

lxc_20b7cc063e8327d0.text: To show the suit on screen, the team used two ways together.

lxc_cc525b97ab344ecf.text: Actors wore real armor costumes for some scenes.

lxc_a8bfdabc10912498.text: For other scenes, the suit was made with computer effects, called CGI.

lxc_fe27e776d6578d21.text: A company named Industrial Light and Magic did much of this work.

lxc_e474272c0f046713.text: Real parts and computer parts were mixed, so the armor looked heavy and real.

lxc_ba7243b03161c982.text: Iron Man is not only a hero alone.

lxc_3ffd1e134acdb50b.text: In the comics, he was one of the founding members of the Avengers.

lxc_bb1a46e22968f660.text: The Avengers are a team of Marvel heroes who fight together.

lxc_eebab2853fde1024.text: So from early on, Iron Man fought both alone and with that team.

lxc_bc6d368b58949496.text: The 2008 film had a similar job on screen.

lxc_7138445d7c7949d3.text: It was the first MCU film, and it helped start the shared Marvel Cinematic Universe and the Avengers film era.

lxc_eef5fefaa2d4b231.text: The smart inventor, the red and gold armor, and the first MCU film kept Iron Man in view for years.
